component.name: Chiron
component.summary: Linux AppImage frontend for launching emulators (Pegasus fork)

description.p: Chiron is a Linux AppImage-focused fork of Pegasus Frontend for browsing your game library and launching emulators and store-installed games from one place.
This fork adds Linux GOG discovery for Heroic/Dark1HGL installs (including Proton/Windows titles) while keeping native GOG Games start.sh support.
